# AgentDFIR

> Open-source digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) framework for AI agents. Collects, preserves, reconstructs and investigates activity from Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI and other agentic AI tools. Core principle: AI-generated text is never automatically treated as factual evidence of execution — every action is classified REQUESTED / REPORTED / OBSERVED / CORROBORATED / CONTRADICTED / UNKNOWN.

Status: released (v5.0.0, 2026-10-26). v5 adds a MITRE coverage engine, evidence-aware detections and a cross-case graph: ATLAS 2026.09 and ATT&CK Enterprise v20.0 are embedded from SHA-256-pinned releases; all 208 ATLAS techniques are classified in a relevance inventory checked in CI (63 direct, 41 supporting, 14 unobservable, 90 out of scope; 30 of 31 P0 observable techniques covered, AML.T0077 LLM Response Rendering is a documented exception), with OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 and Agentic Applications 2026 references, shown by `agentdfir rules coverage [--json] [--format md]`; strict validation migrated six revoked ATT&CK IDs with a recorded migration. Normalized tool calls carry args_digest, arg_keys, allowlisted redacted safe_args, result_digest/result_status/result_ref, tool_def_digest, mcp_server_version, a recorded approval_state (never inferred from completion), permission_change events, parent_tool_call_id, principal, resource_id, exec_env and input_modality — never raw arguments, results or secrets. Ten new rules read them (AGENT_CREDENTIAL_TO_EXTERNAL_TOOL, MCP_ARGUMENT_BEHAVIOR_MISMATCH, MCP_TOOL_IDENTITY_DRIFT, AGENT_UNAUTHORIZED_RESOURCE_CHANGE, AGENT_PERMISSION_STATE_DRIFT, AGENT_AUTONOMOUS_RECON_SEQUENCE, AGENT_ADAPTIVE_ATTACK_SEQUENCE, AGENT_DELEGATION_SCOPE_EXPANSION, AGENT_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION, AGENT_MULTIMODAL_TRIGGER_CHAIN); each states its limits (mismatch is not compromise, missing approval is not unauthorized, recon can be legitimate, sequence is not causation). Seven new attack chains (20 built in) with link conditions and a redacted link_reason. `correlate-cases --graph` emits a typed cross-case graph with strong, moderate and weak joins, each with time relation and evidence on both sides; weak joins never raise a finding; cross-case findings AGENT_CROSS_HOST_ACTIVITY and CHAIN_CROSS_HOST_AGENT_PROPAGATION. 236 deterministic detections (151 built-in incl. 20 attack chains and 2 cross-case findings + 85 pack rules), 170 HIGH/CRITICAL of which 168 are MITRE-mapped (37 ATLAS, 82 ATT&CK techniques). Go module path: github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/v5. Earlier: v4.5 shows the proof behind every agent action and how complete it is: `report --format proof` gives, per tool call, the evidence chain (human → agent → tool call → process → file / network / cloud resource → outcome) with each step's state, assurance and limitations; coverage is judged per telemetry kind, per host and per telemetry file, with collection health from sequence gaps and drop signals (HEALTHY / PARTIAL / UNKNOWN), and a PARTIAL window never disproves a command (v4's single coverage window could let one kind of telemetry stand in for another; fixed). `collect --image` adds APFS, HFS+/HFSX, UDIF .dmg and sparsebundle, XFS, Btrfs, QCOW2 and LVM2 linear volumes, plus the NTFS USN journal, deleted MFT records (`--recover-deleted`, content labelled RECOVERED_UNVERIFIED) and Volume Shadow Copies (`--include-vss`); FileVault-encrypted APFS volumes, LZVN/LZFSE-compressed files, ReFS and others are reported UNSUPPORTED. New second witnesses: macOS Endpoint Security through Apple's own eslogger (root + Full Disk Access; no native ES client, no entitlement; `monitor --es`), the unified log and opt-in macOS host state (`--include-macos-host`); Tetragon, Falco, bpftrace, docker and podman events (imported; no in-tree eBPF loader); Windows registry, scheduled-task, WMI, logon and PowerShell 4103 events. `collect --suite-export` reads Cellebrite UFDR report.xml (generic structure), .ufd/.ufdx, Magnet AXIOM CSV and Portable Case, Plaso and Autopsy exports (AXIOM Case.mfdb sealed, inventoried and reported UNSUPPORTED: undocumented schema; suite fixtures synthetic). New commands: `monitor --record` black-box recorder (`--auditd`, `--tail`, `--es`, `--retain`; `monitor status`), `reconstruct` (one incident across cases), `supply-chain` (origin, hash history and drift of skills, plugins, hooks and MCP servers), `verify --reproduce` (re-run a recorded analysis, compare the findings fingerprint); findings.stix.json is a valid STIX 2.1 bundle; .adfir spec revision 0.2.2. At v4.5: 217 detections. Synthetic benchmark suites: 41 disk-image fixtures (source unchanged 41/41), 72/72 per-OS corroboration checks, 17/17 suite records, 24/24 tamper mutations, Python verifier 27/27 packages VERIFIED — not real-world accuracy and no comparison with other products. Earlier: v4.0 extends collection from coding agents to every AI evidence source: `collect --image` reads E01 / raw / split / VHD / VHDX / VMDK images directly (MBR/GPT; NTFS, ext2/3/4, FAT12/16/32, exFAT; pure Go, nothing mounted; encrypted and unsupported volumes named, never skipped); `collect --ai-export` seals ChatGPT, Claude.ai, DeepSeek and Gemini (Takeout) account exports and imports UFDR layouts (an export is the provider's record: its tool calls are never CONFIRMED against the machine); `--include-browser` (opt-in only) adds AI-service visits from browser history, never content; Continue (full sessions) and Windsurf (rules, memories, MCP; Cascade stores sealed, content UNSUPPORTED) collectors; second witnesses from raw Windows .evtx (Sysmon, Security 4688, PowerShell 4104), DNS, web proxy, auth.log/journald, Kubernetes, GitHub/GitLab and object-storage audit logs (partial witnesses corroborate, never contradict); `gaps` (what the case does not show, what to collect next), `lineage` (evidence-backed human → agent → tool → process → destination graph; text/json/mermaid/dot), `correlate-cases` (what verified cases share); `extensions` (IDE extensions, agent plugins, skills); `report --format rsmf` and `export --production` (RSMF 2.0, production sets, derivative-only redaction; structural validation, no admissibility claim); `benchmark` (synthetic corpus: 100% precision/recall on its own labeled fixtures — not real-world accuracy; independent-corpus metrics are separate — 24/24 tamper mutations detected, 0 dangling provenance references, 5/5 historical packages verify); an independent stdlib-only Python verifier and conformance fixtures for .adfir spec 0.2.1; `report accountability`, `export custody` and `selfcheck --offline`. Go module path at v4: github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/v4 (commands, flags, exit codes and .adfir 0.2 packages unchanged). The explorer (`agentdfir serve`) is an investigation workbench: Sessions tab (one risk-sorted card per session with metadata and corroboration bar), attack chains (toxic combinations: ordered event sequences such as injection → self-modification → shell, matched in one session, or across the case when steps share a linked value, within a time window, 20 built-in, JSON-extensible), Proof, Supply chain, Reconstruct, Coverage (per-kind health, collection-health badge), Who did what (lineage), Second witness side-by-side, AI conversations, Extensions, Bookmarks and Compare cases (`serve --compare`) views, the investigation tree under every finding (steps in order and what led to each: prompt before, tool result consumed, spawn), whole-case search (events, findings, raw artifact bytes; Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette: fuzzy jump to any view, finding or conversation plus live evidence matches), and a hash-chained analyst case file (verdicts, pins, tags, notes) rendered into PDF/HTML reports. One command does the common case: `agentdfir run` = detect every installed agent → collect into one sealed package → analyze → open the browser explorer; install-and-run in one line — macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/efij/AgentDFIR/main/install.sh | sh && ~/.local/bin/agentdfir run`; Windows (x64/ARM64, PowerShell): `$env:AGENTDFIR_RUN=1; irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/efij/AgentDFIR/main/install.ps1 | iex`. Since v2.7: `agentdfir mitigate` turns findings into guardrails in the agents' own settings (Claude Code permissions + log-guard hook, Codex rules, Cursor CLI denies, MCP pins), planned first, backed up, ledgered and reversible; `agentdfir export` / `agentdfir open` move a case to another computer in one file. Since v3.0: `agentdfir hunt` checks a machine for eight known 2025–2026 incidents (Nx s1ngularity, Shai-Hulud 1 and 2, the keyv wave, SANDWORM_MODE, postmark-mcp, codexui-android, Amazon Q wiper) plus STIX 2.1 / MISP feeds, classifying each hit as OBSERVED / SEEN_IN_OUTPUT / MENTIONED; `agentdfir scan-repo` checks a repository before an AI agent opens it (committed SessionStart hooks, VS Code folderOpen tasks, project MCP servers, injected AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) with SARIF output and a GitHub Action; an offline decoder unwraps nested base64/gzip/hex/UTF-16LE payloads for the rules; `monitor --journal` makes transcripts tamper-evident. Supported products: Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Codex CLI and desktop app, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Copilot Chat for VS Code, Cline, Roo Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Aider, Warp, Continue (full parsers), plus Windsurf and Kiro configuration; streaming analysis for multi-GB packages, signed product packs for adding new agents without code.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/): what AI agent forensics is and what AgentDFIR does
- [Claude Code Forensic Artifacts](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/claude-code-forensic-artifacts): artifact locations, JSONL schema, collection
- [Detection Coverage](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/detection-coverage.md): generated matrix of every built-in and pack rule → MITRE ATLAS 2026.09 and ATT&CK Enterprise v20.0 technique; `agentdfir rules list --packs rules --json`
- [Install](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/install.md): portable raw binaries (air-gap/USB; Windows x64 and ARM64), install.sh (macOS/Linux), install.ps1 (Windows), Homebrew tap, go install; SHA256 + Sigstore verification; why macOS Gatekeeper / Windows SmartScreen prompt on unsigned downloads and the one-step fix
- [Case Explorer](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/serve.md): agentdfir serve — local browser UI: sessions, attack chains, investigation tree, timeline scrubber, raw evidence, whole-case search, case notes, topology; loopback only
- [Attack Chains](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/attack-chains.md): toxic combinations — the 20 built-in chains, link conditions and link_reason, matching semantics, step predicates, writing *.chains.json packs
- [Container / CI Collection](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/container-ci-collection.md): collect --docker and --archive — containers, CI artifacts, support bundles, vendor exports
- [Disk Images](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/disk-images.md): collect --image — E01/raw/split/VHD/VHDX/VMDK/QCOW2/DMG, MBR/GPT/LVM2, NTFS (USN journal, deleted records, VSS)/ext2-4/FAT/exFAT, image-provenance.jsonl, what is not read and the mount-then-import route
- [AI-service Exports](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/ai-service-exports.md): collect --ai-export — ChatGPT, Claude.ai, DeepSeek, Gemini Takeout, UFDR layout import; evidence class, JSON Pointer provenance, coverage
- [Browser AI Sessions](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/browser-ai-sessions.md): opt-in --include-browser — AI-service visits from Chromium/Firefox/Safari history; only listed services kept, never conversation content
- [Continue and Windsurf](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/ai-ide-products.md): collectors, Continue session parsing, Windsurf rules/memories/MCP, Cascade UNSUPPORTED
- [Investigation layer](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/investigation-graph.md): agentdfir gaps, lineage and correlate-cases (incl. --graph: graded cross-case joins, cross-host findings) — schemas, edge bases, honest limits
- [v4 Detections](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/detection-v4.md): new agent-behaviour rules and chains, dedupe verdicts, what was not built and why
- [Extensions and Plugins](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/extensions-plugins.md): agentdfir extensions — IDE extension, agent plugin and skill inventory and heuristics
- [eDiscovery](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/ediscovery.md): report --format rsmf, export --production, derivative-only redaction
- [Benchmark](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/benchmark.md): agentdfir benchmark (synthetic) — detection, integrity and cross-platform suites (acquisition, per-OS corroboration, forensic interop) — and the independent Python .adfir verifier
- [macOS Filesystems](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/macos-filesystems.md): APFS, HFS+/HFSX, UDIF .dmg, sparsebundle — what is read, what is UNSUPPORTED (FileVault, LZVN/LZFSE), fixture origin
- [Linux Filesystems](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/linux-filesystems.md): XFS, Btrfs, QCOW2, LVM2 — coverage, UNSUPPORTED variants, fixture origin
- [macOS Telemetry](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/macos-telemetry.md): eslogger (Endpoint Security via Apple's binary), unified log, monitor --es, --include-macos-host, macOS rules
- [Linux Telemetry](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/linux-telemetry.md): Tetragon, Falco, bpftrace, docker/podman events import (no eBPF loader), container attribution, privilege changes, persistence
- [Forensic-suite Interop](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/forensic-suite-interop.md): collect --suite-export — UFDR, UFD, AXIOM CSV / Portable Case, Case.mfdb UNSUPPORTED, Plaso, Autopsy
- [Action Proof](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/action-proof.md): report --format proof — per-action evidence chain, per-kind and per-host coverage, collection health
- [Black-box Recorder](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/black-box-recorder.md): monitor --record — journaled transcripts, OS telemetry and MCP config changes, retention, monitor status
- [Incident Reconstruction](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/reconstruct.md): agentdfir reconstruct — one incident across cases: timeline, delegation, hand-offs, stages, missing evidence
- [Agent Supply Chain](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/supply-chain.md): agentdfir supply-chain — component origin, hash history, drift, verified vs inferred links, supply-chain rules
- [ATLAS Coverage](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/atlas-coverage.md): generated — all 208 MITRE ATLAS 2026.09 techniques classified (direct / supporting / unobservable / out of scope, P0–P2) with rules, chains, evidence sources, tests, OWASP LLM 2025 / Agentic 2026 references and documented exceptions; `agentdfir rules coverage`
- [v5 Detections](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/detection-v5.md): rules on structured tool-call evidence (P0 and P1/P2), dedupe decisions including dropped and extended proposals, fields read, limits
- [v4.5 Detections](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/detection-v45.md): host-witness rules and transfer chains, dedupe verdicts, telemetry prerequisites
- [Open Evidence Standard](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/open-evidence-standard.md): verifying a case without trusting AgentDFIR — analysis manifest, verify --reproduce, action graph and STIX checks
- [Instruction Provenance](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/provenance.md): who wrote each line of CLAUDE.md / rules / settings and whether it came from a tool result
- [Real-time Detection](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/realtime-detection.md): monitor --detect --alert — live sensor pushing findings to webhook/syslog/file
- [Endpoint Corroboration](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/endpoint-corroboration.md): auditd / Sysmon / raw .evtx / EDR exports, DNS / proxy / auth / journald / Kubernetes / Git-hosting / storage logs, and AWS CloudTrail / Azure Activity Log / GCP Cloud Audit Log exports for az/aws/gcloud commands, as a second witness — CORROBORATED vs CONTRADICTED tool calls, unlogged agent activity
- [MCP Audit](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/mcp-audit.md): read-only MCP server inventory + supply-chain findings across 9 agent hosts, baseline drift, gateway-log corroboration
- [MCP Forensics](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/mcp-forensics): MCP config and tool-activity investigation; what a normalized tool call retains (digests, argument names, allowlisted values, recorded outcome and approval)
- [Hunt](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/hunt.md): agentdfir hunt — was this machine hit by a known AI-agent or npm supply-chain incident; IOC packs, STIX 2.1 / MISP import, lockfile checks, evidence-window verdicts
- [Scan a repository](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/scan-repo.md): agentdfir scan-repo — committed agent hooks, folderOpen tasks, repo MCP servers and instruction injection, before an agent opens the folder; SARIF, GitHub Action, pre-commit
- [Offline payload decoding](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/decode.md): nested base64/base32/hex/gzip/zlib/bzip2/UTF-16LE decoding feeding every command rule
- [Accountability](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/accountability.md): agentdfir report accountability — for every consequential action, who asked (human prompt or tool result), what was allowed (permission state captured at that round), what the agent did (event, evidence state, witness, masked command, target) and whether it went beyond the instruction (deterministic gap codes, never "authorized"); md/json/html, JSON schema
- [Evidence authentication](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/evidence-authentication.md): how a case authenticates itself (seal chain, archived seals, SEAL.sig, anchors, custody hash chain) with reproduction commands for AgentDFIR and standard tools; US FRE 902(13)/902(14) context and ISO/IEC 27037 note; agentdfir export custody (chain-of-custody bundle + pre-filled certification template) and agentdfir case authorize; not legal advice, never "admissible"/"compliant"
- [Offline self-check](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/selfcheck.md): agentdfir selfcheck --offline — prove on your own machine that a collection + analysis opens no socket, spawns no process and writes only inside the case/state dirs; sandbox-exec (macOS) / unshare+strace (Linux) / in-process guard; levels kernel-enforced, traced, in-process; connectivity canary so a non-enforcing sandbox never passes
- [Mitigate](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/mitigate.md): agentdfir mitigate — guardrail packs, fix-now controls, the ledger, drift and revert
- [SIEM Interop](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/siem-interop.md): OCSF 1.3, SARIF 2.1 and Sigma export for SIEM/SOC pipelines
- [DFIR Interop](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/dfir-interop.md): import KAPE/Velociraptor/CyLR trees; export Timesketch JSONL and l2tcsv timelines
- [Product Packs](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/product-packs.md): add a new AI agent product with one signed JSON file (detection + collector manifest + parser field map)
- [.adfir Package Spec](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/adfir-spec): the open evidence-package format
- [Event JSON Schema](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/schema/event.schema.json)
- [Finding JSON Schema](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/schema/finding.schema.json)

## Facts

- License: MIT (free, open source)
- Language: Go, single static binary, zero third-party runtime dependencies in the collector core
- Evidence package format: .adfir (sealed, content-addressed, hash-chained custody, independently parseable)

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR): source, issues, releases
